purpose: Run one diagnostic-only copy of the native TCT baseline with the evidenced M3D-C1 magnetic-probe interface enabled, preserving plasma and actuator physics, to capture and inventory the native magnetic probe time series before constructing any precursor.

interpretation_contract.forbidden_substitution: Do not substitute Jpk, dJpk/dt, sheet width, generic flux/current scalars, or FAIR-MAST absolute milliseconds for a physically identified native magnetic probe.
interpretation_contract.gate_note: No efficacy gate is evaluated by this diagnostic-only run; any later controller claim must retain the frozen gates without loosening them.
interpretation_contract.claim_boundary: Normalized native M3D-C1 magnetic diagnostic capture only; no precursor lead-time, controller-efficacy, experimental, or reactor-scale claim.
